lines: Only the sound of grass and leaves swaying in the wind could be heard.
We faced each other in silence, and the only thing I could hear was the trembling of my own heartbeat.
Gennosuke
Me
The pressure radiating from him was so intense that I felt the urge to take a step back.
The monster before me, which seemed far larger than his actual frame, appeared to be glaring at me as if trying to swallow me whole.
My hands were drenched in sweat, causing the hilt to slip, and I had to grip it over and over again.
But the more I hesitated, the more my fear grew.
Making up my mind, I took a deep breath to steady myself and then charged straight at him.
Me
Haaah!
Gennosuke
My full-power strike cut through the air with ease.
Gennosuke had already vanished, and I nearly doubted my own eyes.
However, I knew where he had dodged to.
If he was in a place I couldn't see, it could only be behind me.
I shifted my weight back after the spin and turned my body to deliver a second blow.
But—
Me
Ghah!
A heavy blade struck my torso.
Even though it wasn't a real sword, the impact was so powerful that I couldn't help but crumple to the ground.
The onlookers erupted in a murmur.
Everyone
Oh...
I couldn't bring myself to make a sound right away, but if I had been watching that exchange, I would have made the same noise.
This was a vast, open grassland near my home, devoid of any foot traffic.
What was being held here was a swordsmanship training session between me and Gennosuke.
Of course, I had bowed my head and begged him to do it.
Gennosuke agreed readily, so I invited Shikanosuke, Aishu Hebiko, Tokiko, and Library, who were equally interested.
When word spread that Gennosuke would be training with me, even more people came to watch.
There were various people, including lower-ranking Fuuma ninjas and the Imperial Guards.
After all, Gennosuke was wielding a genuine, ancient style of swordsmanship, making it a rare experience to witness.
It was embarrassing to show such a defeated form.
But more than that, I was moved watching his swordplay up close.
Aishu Hebiko
Whoa! Gennosuke-san is amazing...! I couldn't see any of his movements at all...
Uehara Shikanosuke
...H-Holy crap! It was just an instant, an instant!! What the hell is that swordsmanship... incredible
The two I had brought along were also shouting in excitement, their eyes sparkling.
Library
My, what a magnificent battle. I have had the privilege of witnessing a truly precious moment.
Library
My lord fought valiantly. I felt you had grown quite a bit, but there is still much room for improvement.
Me
Yeah...
As I smiled wryly, Gennosuke approached and smoothly extended his hand to me.
Gennosuke
Kotaro, are you in pain?
Me
Thank you. Oh, by the way, I don't feel any pain... I thought I got hit pretty hard.
While taking Gennosuke's hand, I noticed that my pain had subsided.
I should have been struck by a breath-taking impact, yet I could stand as if nothing had happened.
Is this also part of Gennosuke's skill?
Gennosuke
Did I meet your expectations?
Me
Yes! You showed me more than I expected. No... I can't compare to you, haha.
Gennosuke
Do not belittle yourself so, Kotaro. Your swordsmanship was quite impressive.
Gennosuke
Your eyes were also filled with burning passion. It reached my eyes clearly.
Me
Ah, thank you!
Gennosuke's expression was completely different when he was not holding a sword.
He was gentle and approachable.
If he had been the terrifying person he showed on the battlefield, I would not have been able to rely on him so easily.
But I believe the Gennosuke with that fierce expression is also undeniably part of him.
Both sides of this duality have something that strongly draws people in.
As I was feeling that way, someone pushed through the crowd to approach us.
Tsuru
Pardon me. It is about time, so would you all please return to the residence?
Tsuru
The Master seems tired as well, so perhaps you could take a break here? I would be happy to prepare some delicious tea for you.
Me
Ah, I see! In that case, Gennosuke-san, how about we head back to the house and have some tea together?
Gennosuke
Oh my, I am deeply honored. Then I shall accept your hospitality.
And so, after finishing one match, we headed back to the house, chatting as we went.
While Tsuru was preparing the tea, we talked about the swordsmanship practice we had just done.
Fuuma Tokiko
Gennosuke-san, you were truly impressive. You are still quite young, are you not...? You must have honed your skills considerably.
Gennosuke
Nonsense. I am still one who strives to improve myself every day.
Fuuma Tokiko
Without any arrogance, remaining calm and composed... I am deeply impressed by that spirit.
Fuuma Tokiko
...Do you not agree, Master?
Tokiko gave me a flat look, staring at me as if waiting for a response.
Me
W-what is that look...
Fuuma Tokiko
No. I simply wish that the Master could also possess the composure that Gennosuke-san has.
Me
H-hey! What is that supposed to mean? I thought you were bringing up something else because you suddenly brought it up... I have at least some age-appropriate composure...
Uehara Shikanosuke
No, no! Not at all! Where is the composure in Fuuma? I vote for Tokiko-san's opinion!
Me
Shikanosuke, you!
Aishu Hebiko
Fuuma-chan, right there!
Me
E-even Hebiko... Please, have mercy.
What was supposed to be a conversation with Gennosuke-san had somehow turned into me being condemned and feeling out of place.
Amidst this exchange, Gennosuke-san was, as expected, calm, watching us with a gentle smile.
Gennosuke
There is no need to blame young Kotaro. Being calm is not the only quality required of the Master.
Gennosuke
As far as my eyes can see, young Kotaro is greatly beloved by everyone. That is undoubtedly a strength.
Me
Ah, thank you...
Gennosuke
Besides, young Kotaro. In your recent battle with Ennokimi, you showed quick thinking and found a way out.
Gennosuke
It was truly splendid. As for the usefulness of your efforts, this Koga Gennosuke guarantees it.
The situation had completely reversed from just moments ago, and now Gennosuke-san was praising me highly.
On the other hand, this is also embarrassing in its own way.
Gennosuke-san said that I am liked by everyone, but I think he is the same.
Even I, who am the one being served, find myself wanting to serve him after spending just a little time together.
As I was thinking that, Tsuru arrived accompanied by a sweet scent.
Brought in on a tray was green tea steaming with a pleasant aroma, along with an assortment of sweets to complement it.
Both Western sweets like cookies and chocolate, and Japanese sweets like manju, were prepared.
At the sight of such delicious food, I, of course, and Gennosuke-san both took on even gentler expressions.
Tsuru
Excuse me.
As the sweets were laid out in a row, an even sweeter scent drifted over.
Gennosuke
Tsuru, thank you very much. Hm, those manju look delicious... And... are these foreign sweets?
Me
Yes, they are. They are just as delicious as the manju. Please, do try them.
Gennosuke
In that case, I shall...
Gennosuke-san picked up a cookie, looked at it with some interest, and then popped the whole thing into his mouth.
Just as he seemed interested in the cookies, everyone else also seemed curious about his reaction, watching him intently.
Then, he gave a small nod.
Gennosuke
Mm... truly sweet. The sweetness that lingers on the tongue, the texture against the teeth. Both are things I enjoy.
Me
Oh, I'm glad you liked it. Please, eat as much as you like! There are many other flavors as well.
Gennosuke
Ah, I shall. But... are you sure you don't mind?
Gennosuke
Goods like these... they must be quite precious in the mountains.
Seeing Gennosuke-san hesitate so politely, Tokiko quickly stepped in to reassure him.
Fuuma Tokiko
No, not really. In this day and age, it has become easy to obtain such foreign items.
Gennosuke
I see, is that so?
Fuuma Tokiko
Yes, so please don't worry about it, Gennosuke-san, and help yourself. We will be eating some too.
Gennosuke
Oh, I am truly grateful.
Gennosuke-san bowed his head politely, then picked up another cookie, put it in his mouth, and smiled.
We watched him for a moment before each of us took some sweets and tea, and a relaxed atmosphere spread among us.
In the midst of that, Gennosuke-san suddenly stared at the sweets, seemingly lost in thought.
Me
...Gennosuke-san? Is something wrong?
Gennosuke
No... it was just such a fine product. I wanted my relatives... the members of the Koga Man'yoku Shu... to enjoy it too.
Me
I see.
Gennosuke
Jousuke would surely be delighted... though, since he is a bit of a prankster, he might end up eating it all.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Ahaha, so he's a big eater. Who else is there?
Gennosuke
Kyoubu, who is strong and reliable, but a bit hot-headed.
Gennosuke
Juubei, who never misses when it comes to astrology. Because he has no limbs, he is very agile.
Gennosuke
Saemon, who gives off an ordinary vibe, but can actually change his voice and appearance at will.
Gennosuke
Okogiri, who is skilled in blood ninjutsu and is also Saemon's younger sister.
Gennosuke
Shoukan, who is like a spider that never lets its prey escape, thanks to the strange phlegm he spits out.
Gennosuke
Kagero, who can judge and act calmly. However, her poison is... a bit special.
Gennosuke
Hyoma, who has excellent hearing due to his blindness. He has been my master since I was young.
Gennosuke
And the leader of us Koga Man'yoku Shu. My grandfather, who is also my blood relative.
Me
They all seem to have quite distinct personalities. It sounds like a lot of fun.
Gennosuke
Exactly. That is why they are...
Judging by Gennosuke's expression, he clearly cares deeply about his subordinates.
I would probably feel the same way. If I had the chance to go somewhere else and eat some good food, I would surely want to share it with the people back home.
It is precisely because I understand that feeling that it is so difficult for me to say anything.
But then.
Tsuru, who had been listening silently until now, opened her mouth to Gennosuke.
Tsuru
I fully understand how you feel. However, I am sure everyone understands that you are thinking this way.
Tsuru
I am not speaking on their behalf, but is it not everyone's wish for you to enjoy this place to the fullest?
Fuuma Tokiko
I agree. Just as your happiness is my happiness.
Gennosuke
Tsuru, Tokiko... ...I see, I understand! Then, I shall enjoy myself to the fullest.
Their words reached him clearly, and Gennosuke's face brightened up again.
Aishu Hebiko
Even if we can't bring back food, we can bring back stories as souvenirs, right? I wonder if there is anything interesting...?
Me
Souvenir stories, huh... Hmm. This area doesn't really have any tourist spots... And it would be awkward to go too far.
Fuuma Tokiko
Master, how about a festival?
Me
A festival?
Fuuma Tokiko
Yes, there is one being held in Maesaki City. It is not far off, so what do you think?
Me
I see! That sounds great. Gennosuke, what do you think?
Gennosuke
Yes, I would love to.
Uehara Shikanosuke
Alright! A festival! We are going to eat a ton of good stuff!
Me
Right!
And so, in order to create memories for Gennosuke, we decided to go to the festival being held on the next day off.
